authority.scope: source-neutral local HNC evidence-control component only

process_steps.label: Research record
process_steps.body: Harmonic Nexus Core is Aureon's evolving research and systems-method framework.

process_steps.label: Source + claim state
process_steps.body: Record origin, freshness, permission and the part of the source actually used. Separate observed fact, interpretation, company record and unresolved gap.

process_steps.label: Aureon OS control
process_steps.body: Aureon OS is a company-built engineering and evidence operating system.

process_steps.label: Human gate
process_steps.body: An authorised reviewer accepts, rejects or returns the record before action.

process_steps.label: Bounded decision
process_steps.body: Retain the result, evidence basis, authority and any condition still open.
